@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@2000@@casttime@@0.25@@cost@@50@@cooldown@@6@@targeting@@Unit@@damagetype@@Magic@@spellshield@@True@@projectile@@True@@notes@@ * ''Sigil of Malice'' and [[File:LeBlanc Mimic- Sigil of Malice.png|20xpx|border|link=LeBlanc#Mimic: Sigil of Malice|An icon for LeBlanc's ability Mimic: Sigil of Malice]] [[LeBlanc#Mimic: Sigil of Malice|Mimic: Sigil of Malice]] can detonate each other's marks. * The floating damage text upon the mark's detonation currently displays a real [[File:Critical strike magic icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon for magic damage critical strikes]] critical strike icon instead of a success indicator.(bug) * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).@@
